Changed pulsar-broker/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/broker/service/PulsarCommandSenderImpl.java and wrote the reason down in docs/decisions/pulsar-handoff-coalesced-bytes.md.

Commit message:
Marlow Exchange's consumers are behind a TLS-inspecting appliance that splits writes above one 16 KiB TLS record, adding ~3 ms each; 64 KiB writes tripled their p99 latency.

# Why pulsar-broker/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/broker/service/PulsarCommandSenderImpl.java holds this value

Marlow Exchange's consumers are behind a TLS-inspecting appliance that splits writes above one 16 KiB TLS record, adding ~3 ms each; 64 KiB writes tripled their p99 latency.
